user.title: Sign in to Meoof
user.description: Enter the phone number used by the Meoof app. A verification code will be sent after you submit.

code.title: Enter verification code
code.description: Enter the SMS verification code you just received.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or send a verification code
error.invalid_auth: The verification code is invalid or sign-in failed
error.no_devices: No devices were found for this account

cat_profile.title: Add cat profile photo
cat_profile.description: Enter a cat name and upload a photo. Add several photos under the same name to improve recognition.

recognition.title: External cat recognition
recognition.description: Snapshots are uploaded only after feeding activity is detected and recognition is enabled. The endpoint must support the OpenAI chat/completions vision format.

smart_feed.title: Smart feed suppression
smart_feed.description: Before scheduled feeding, read today's plan and capture a fresh camera frame. Only cancel this one occurrence when the model reports a high food level above the confidence threshold. Camera, model or verification failures allow feeding to continue. A working vision API is required.

reauth.title: Reauthenticate
reauth.description: Enter the phone number, submit it, and then enter the SMS verification code.
